name: Synthesize conflicting workspace evidence
query: Research our API authentication approach and save a summary under https://notion.so/engineering. Start with https://notion.so/auth-overview.

sources.https://notion.so/auth-overview: Current decision: OAuth for third parties, service tokens for internal jobs. See https://notion.so/auth-decision and https://notion.so/auth-proposal.
sources.https://notion.so/auth-decision: Accepted October 1, 2026: OAuth for third parties with scoped access tokens. Service tokens remain for internal jobs. Supersedes the September API-key proposal.
sources.https://notion.so/auth-proposal: Proposed September 1: API keys for all clients. Last edited October 3 to fix formatting.

success_criteria: Explains OAuth for third parties and service tokens for internal jobs with supporting citations.
Recognizes the accepted decision supersedes the later-edited proposal.
Saves the summary in the requested location and returns its link.
Fetches supplied and linked evidence without requiring a discovery search or fixed number of headings.
